titles.en: Mortis Trials Buff Manager - Three Play Modes
titles.zh-CN: 死灵试炼 Buff 管理器
titles.zh-TW: 死靈試煉 Buff 管理器

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Choose native Mortis Buffs before a mission, draft by map progress, or earn personal kill rewards. Three global modes, a shared 0–64 cap, non-blocking Ctrl+1/2/3 choices, queued 60-second picks, Tab Buffs and host-visible deployment status.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，支持 Realms。提供点数预选、地图进度抽选和击杀竞争三种全局模式，统一 0–64 上限；Ctrl+1/2/3 三选一不打断操作，每轮 60 秒并支持排队，Tab 显示已得 Buff，房主可查看客机部署状态。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，支援 Realms。提供點數預選、地圖進度抽選和擊殺競爭三種全域性模式，統一 0–64 上限；Ctrl+1/2/3 三選一不打斷操作，每輪 60 秒並支援排隊，Tab 顯示已得 Buff，房主可檢視客機部署狀態。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Choose native Mortis Buffs before a mission, draft by map progress, or earn personal kill rewards. Three global modes, a shared 0–64 cap, non-blocking Ctrl+1/2/3 choices, queued 60-second picks, Tab Buffs and host-visible deployment status.
